items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has a legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach comments, but same left knee had PCL sprain and bone bruise last season—scary history.
items.why: Meniscus trim; coach says working tail off, realistic Week 2 chance per Schefter sources too.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Michael Mayer elevated if out again.
items.opportunity: Mayer temporary TE1 volume if Bowers sits.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; team wants to see how he feels this week before Week 2 availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib/chest injury from hard hit; monitored all week, status up in air.
items.implication: Game-time or sit risk; Tre Harris beneficiary if out.
items.opportunity: If out, elevated snaps/routes for depth WRs.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring not considered serious; day-to-day, would have returned if playoff game. MRI done; coach confirms DTD. Schefter later called Week 2 play unrealistic.
items.why: Aggravated preseason hamstring; not serious but soft tissue caution early season.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Bateman/Moore upside if sits.
items.opportunity: If OUT, more targets for Bateman and depth.

items.text: Ravens ruled out WR Ja'Kobi Lane due to wrist injury (fractured, several weeks).
items.opportunity: Immediate WR2/3 snaps and targets for Bateman.

items.text: Week 2 injury beneficiaries on waivers: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; Omar Cooper=Adonai Mitchell. Plus streamers and FAAB guidance.
items.why: Direct injury replacements listed with streaming options.
items.implication: Prioritize these adds if corresponding stars sit/out.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. He fucks.
items.why: Handled nearly all early RB work; high routes + targets in Mahomes offense.
items.implication: Every-down RB1 lock ROS; elite usage profile.
items.opportunity: Snaps, carries, routes, targets, GL all concentrated.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty ascends to high-end RB1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 att/6 tgt, 156 yds from scrimmage + 2 TDs. Utilization 99 tied Bijan. Every-down player.
items.why: Dominant utilization + efficiency gains vs Dolphins; Kubiak scheme + O-line upgrades.
items.implication: Start as RB1 weekly; buy if available.

items.text: Travis Etienne downgrades to low-end RB2: only 58% snaps/43% attempts/38% routes in 3-way committee even without Kamara. 14.8 pts inflated by 86 plays. Kamara return looming.
items.why: Split work despite Kamara absence; low route share.
items.implication: Flex/RB2 risk; Kendre Miller handcuff/beneficiary if Kamara out again.
items.opportunity: If Kamara sits, Etienne volume rises but still committee.

items.text: Lions incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2 usage, WR3 can't earn targets, no TE2.
items.why: Elite offense funnels nearly all work to four players.
items.implication: Core four locked as must-starts; ignore depth.

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage (8 carries, 21 routes, 7/7 targets) but got only RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy. Great CLE matchup next.
items.why: Clear edge in routes/GL over Gainwell; healthy post-draft concerns.
items.implication: Mid-RB2 floor with upside; start confidently.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9, last night 2.5; only 2 targets (7% share) but routes solid (29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks, 2nd behind Worthy). Needs volume to pay off.
items.why: Tiny aDOT limits big plays; routes confirm involvement but target share low.
items.opportunity: High route share if targets rise.

items.text: David Montgomery upgrades high-end RB2: 65% attempts, all inside-5, 58% short-yardage vs Bills despite 50-50 reports. 28.9 pts (3 TDs). Woody Marks two-minute only.
items.why: Clear early-down/GL lead; historical comps mid-RB1/high-RB2.
items.implication: Reliable RB2 starter; TD-dependent but volume secure.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early; Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes too.
items.why: Low passing-game involvement despite backfield injury.
items.implication: Pure rusher profile limits ceiling; committee risk.

items.text: Malik Nabers active Week 1 (decided ~2 hrs pre-kick; family skipped due to uncertainty). Knee status cleared enough to play.
items.why: Game-time decision flipped to active despite knee.
items.implication: Cleared hurdle; monitor for lingering effects ROS.
